name: flight
description: Flight — full system. Embark/charter/buy aircraft at six airfields; fly the map_world tile grid on a real-time posture tick loop through interactive takeoff/glideslope/targeting decks, OR ride an NPC-pilot charter as a passenger. Phase B hazards, no-fly airspace, cargo/passenger + smuggling contracts, ground AA + air combat, hangars, wreck salvage/rebuild, owner-only customization, and engine-noise propagation. The aircraft is a first-class object owning its occupant set; the cockpit HUD is synthesized per-aircraft.

board.note: KNOWN GAP: boards a parked aircraft row (aircraft.parked_zone_id). Aircraft are DB rows, not furniture/items/NPCs, so they can never appear in an examine Actions line — discovered via airfield look/ambience text.

buy.note: KNOWN GAP: gated on the airfield's `dealer` column, reached from the tile's airfield_id. Not an examinable object.

charter.note: KNOWN GAP: gated on the airfield's `charter` column, reached from the tile's airfield_id. Opens the visual charter dialog (charter_open push).

charterinfo.note: Alias of `charter` — the hangar-bay's CHARTER tile calls this to (re)open the dialog.

charterbook.note: Books + charges a destination chosen in the charter dialog (`charterbook <destZoneId> [any]`); not typed directly.

refuel.note: KNOWN GAP: aboard an aircraft at a field with fuel stock; aircraft/zone-flag gate, not examinable.

contracts.note: KNOWN GAP: contract board is a zone flag, no board furniture.

hangar.note: KNOWN GAP: zone-flag gate. Opens the unified 3D hangar-bay app (hangar_bay_open push) — floor (your craft + the CHARTER Mule) with Charter/Buy-Rent/Maintenance sub-screens.

fleet.note: Alias for `hangar` open (legacy name for the same unified app).

view.note: `view <tail>` opens the hangar-bay pre-selected on one craft's maintenance bench; generic verb, returns undefined off-field to fall through rather than hijack it.

repair.note: KNOWN GAP: owned aircraft row + zone flag airfield_id; shadows the engine gear-repair builtin and falls through when no craft.

salvage.note: KNOWN GAP: wreck aircraft row (is_wreck=1) in zone; not examinable furniture.

rebuild.note: KNOWN GAP: wreck row + zone flag airfield_id.

tune.note: KNOWN GAP: owned aircraft row + zone flag airfield_id (distinct from broadcast's tune).

tuneset.note: Commits all four tuning dials at once from the maintenance bench (`tuneset <id> <mix> <pitch> <boost> <cg>` floats); not typed directly.

installkit.note: Buys + fits an upgrade kit from the maintenance bench (`installkit <id> <kitId>`); owned aircraft row + zone flag airfield_id.

sell.note: Owned aircraft row. Takes an internal id (what the panel's buttons pass) OR the TAIL NAME, which is what a player can actually see and type — before that it was panel-only. Still shadows commerce's item-sell and falls through when the argument matches neither an id nor one of your aircraft.

cancelrental.note: Rental aircraft row, by id or tail name; a lone rental needs no argument at all.

flushairborne.note: Anti-stuck recovery (alias `groundall`) for a craft left flagged airborne with nobody aboard — a crashed tab, a lost connection, a restart. Was a Tablet Vehicles button ONLY, which made an unrecoverable plane a permanent loss for a player who didn't use the tablet.

deadhead.note: Dispatches your Leviathan while you are NOT aboard (to <airfield> / hold <x> <y> / here). remoteDispatchField+remoteDispatchLoiter were reachable only from the DEADHEAD tablet app, so an owner without a tablet could never send for her. Aboard, it deliberately refuses and points at the real verbs rather than duplicating them.

extensionPoints: aircraft.companions — gather-hook FIRED by flight at boarding (never handled here); return { npc } for an NPC that should ride along with this player. Seat-checked, pulled out of the world and frozen like a charter pilot, set down where the occupants land (with an `npc.transported` event), and killed with the airframe in a crash. The escort plugin answers it.
